description: `->(x) { x + 1 }.call(2)`: the stabby-lambda syntax desugars to the *exact same* shape as `lambda { .. }` (`send none "lambda"`), so a checker needs one rule, not two. Nothing declares `x`'s type: it has to come from the body (`x + 1` is typeable only at Int, given PrimSig) or from the call site's argument -- the same parameter-inference question tier 6 asks about `def`.
